newsitem.title: YEMEN: Iraqi envoy in Yemen for talks on sanctions.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi envoy in Yemen for talks on sanctions.

text.p: Iraq's Justice Minister Shabib al-Maliki arrived in the Yemen capital Sanaa on Saturday for talks on sanctions imposed on Baghdad, the official SABA news agency said.
"As an envoy of (Iraqi) President Saddam Hussein, I will brief President Ali Abdullah Saleh on efforts to lift unfair sanctions imposed on the Iraqi people," SABA quoted Shabib as saying.
President Saleh called last week for an immediate lifting of the U.N. sanctions imposed on Iraq after its invasion of Kuwait in 1990.
The United Nations gave Iraq clearance in December for limited oil exports under an " oil-for-food" deal to buy relief aid for Iraqis suffering from the stringent sanctions.
